test_title: PYST 42: RRB Group D - Mathematics (Held On: 15 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question:
A shopkeeper announces the following three discount schemes. Which scheme is the most beneficial for the customer?

A. Buy 5 items and get 2 identical items free

B. Two successive discounts of 13% and 38%

C. Two equal successive discounts of 21%
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Scheme A: Buy 5 get 22 free ⇒ pay for 5, get 27 ⇒ effective discount = (22/27) × 100 ≈ 81.48%

Scheme B: 13% and 38% successive ⇒ net = 1 − (0.87 × 0.62) = 46.06%

Scheme C: 21% twice ⇒ net = 1 − (0.79 × 0.79) = 37.59%

Compare: 81.48% > 46.06% > 37.59%

**∴ Answer = Scheme A is most beneficial**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Three discount schemes A, B, C

**Formula used:**

Successive discount = 1 − (product of remaining fractions)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Scheme A: Buy 5 get 22 free

⇒ Total items = 5 + 22 = 27

⇒ Effective discount = (22 ÷ 27) × 100 ≈ 81.48%

⇒ Scheme B: 13% and 38%

⇒ Net discount = 1 − (0.87 × 0.62) = 1 − 0.5394 = 46.06%

⇒ Scheme C: 21% and 21%

⇒ Net discount = 1 − (0.79 × 0.79) = 1 − 0.6241 = 37.59%

⇒ Comparing all: Scheme A gives highest discount

**∴ The correct answer is Scheme A.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount

Net discount = 1 − (1 − d1)(1 − d2)

Free Item Concept

Effective discount = Free items ÷ Total items × 100

Comparison Trick

Convert all schemes into percentage discount

Key Insight

Higher effective discount ⇒ better scheme
